objective: Retry corregido del Gate 8E R3. Auditar metadata no secreta de dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig para determinar si existen config/provider/template canonicos reutilizables para Catalogo Ampliado EMAIL/WHATSAPP. La consulta debe tolerar filas legacy cuyo PayloadMongo no sea JSON valido usando ISJSON antes de JSON_VALUE. No exponer secretos, destinatarios ni template_texto. Sin DML/DDL, sin envios, sin Produccion.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: notification_config_json_health
queries.sql: SELECT Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EsJsonValido,COUNT_BIG(*) AS cantidad FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig GROUP BY Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY Activo,EsJsonValido

queries.name: notification_metadata_sanitized
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.id') AS payload_id,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS canal,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo') AS modulo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento') AS evento,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS provider,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio') AS modo_envio,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_codigo') AS template_codigo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo') AS codigo,CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_texto') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tiene_template_texto FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Id

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_config_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS canal,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo') AS modulo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento') AS evento,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS provider,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio') AS modo_envio,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_codigo') AS template_codigo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo') AS codigo,CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_texto') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tiene_template_texto FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 AND (LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo'),'')) IN ('catalogo_ampliado','catalogo ampliado') OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento'),'')) LIKE '%vencim%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo'),'')) LIKE '%vencim%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo'),'')) LIKE '%catalog%') ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Id

constraints: Do not return template_texto content, only whether it exists
Legacy invalid JSON rows must not fail the audit
